name: @mizchi/vlmkit-anim
description: Declarative explanatory animation IR: a semantic Scene IR (sorting, arrays with pointers, stacks, queues, linked lists, state machines, heaps, binary search trees, distributed systems, matrices, graphs, charts, concept diagrams, vector; several of them composed in panes; value / callout / snapshot / group / text / relate annotations over named anchors in every kind) compiled to a keyframe Timeline IR, rendered by a tiny SVG + Web Animations web component or sampled headlessly to SVG frames, GIF and video.
